response.sql: WITH station_stats AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avg_telescope_count AS (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) as avg_count FROM station_stats) SELECT ss.observstation, ss.avg_bandwidth, ss.telescope_count, ss.telescope_count / atc.avg_count as ratio FROM station_stats ss CROSS JOIN avg_telescope_count atc ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
